title: GTA6还没发售：30亿可能只是保守估计，八年到底烧出了什么
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: GTA 6 is set to release on November 19th, expected to be one of the biggest entertainment releases in history. The game, which is created by Rockstar Games, a development studio owned by Take 2,
segments.zh: GTA 6定于11月19日发售，预计将成为史上规模最大的娱乐产品之一。该游戏由Rockstar Games开发，这家工作室隶属于Take 2。

segments.en: is expected to generate more than $3 billion in its first four months to take us inside the making of Grandfet Dordo 6, Bloomberg's Jason Shryer who published the pretty much definitive
segments.zh: 预计前四个月将创造超过30亿美元收入。为深入了解《GTA 6》的制作过程，彭博社的Jason Shryer今早发布了堪称最权威的幕后报道。

segments.en: backstory this morning. My first question is why did this take eight years?
segments.zh: 我的第一个问题是，为什么这款游戏花了八年时间？

segments.en: I mean, you know, I think $3 billion actually might be a conservative estimate just to put things in perspective. Yeah, it took eight years for a bunch of reasons. COVID was a big one.
segments.zh: 我觉得30亿美元可能还是保守估计，供大家参考。确实花了八年，原因很多，疫情是重要因素。

segments.en: We don't think about it too much these days or we try not to think about it too much these days but having a pandemic early in production of a game adds probably a year or two to the schedule.
segments.zh: 现在我们不太想这些了，但游戏制作初期遭遇疫情，可能让进度延后一两年。

segments.en: They ran into issues with their vision, trying to figure out what the game was going to look like.
segments.zh: 他们在游戏愿景上遇到了问题，试图弄清楚游戏最终会是什么样子。

segments.en: They lost some key people along the way. They actually doubled in size from around 2400 people working at Rockstar Games on Grandfet Dordo to 4700, which is a monumental thing and that actually
segments.zh: 过程中流失了一些关键人员。实际上，Rockstar Games参与《GTA》开发的人数从约2400人翻倍到4700人，这是巨大的变化。

segments.en: helps you make a lot more stuff but it also brings with it a whole lot of communication issues and coordination issues that can make things take a little bit longer and really games are just
segments.zh: 这有助于制作更多内容，但也带来了大量沟通和协调问题，可能拖慢进度。游戏本身细节就非常复杂。

segments.en: complicated in detail, especially a game like this with probably the biggest virtual world that we have ever seen in a video. So it's just like an amazing story of what it was like to be
segments.zh: 尤其是这样一款游戏，可能拥有视频游戏中前所未有的最大虚拟世界。这真是一个精彩的故事。
